Round 16 · The rebuild, measured against the real thing

Look first. Measure second.

With combat closed in R15, R16 turned to breadth — the biggest remaining distance from the arcade. It shipped a whole missing beat: the refuel interstitial, a no-combat low pass over a runway that restocks your missiles between combat stages. And it closed the one named R15 residual — the first missile lock is now found by the naive climb (3 locks on the first try, where the judge once flew ~15 empty passes). It rises to 8.6 — modest, because the refuel stage reads as a road, not the arcade’s refuel base: it still lacks the tankers, the crew, and the trees-to-the-top framing.
“The first lock just happens now — climb at the wave and it locks, first try. And there’s a fifth beat: a calm refuel runway between combat stages, reachable in real play. It reads as a bare road rather than the arcade’s refuel base, but the wiring is right.”

Next — R17

ranked by what breaks the illusion
  1. 01 MISSING
    The refuel stage is a road, not a BASE

    The round’s headline is its weakest frame. It needs the two signifiers it lacks: the autumn trees that fill the frame to the top (the low-camera swoop), and the ground props — fuel tankers, tents, crew — beside the runway. Also stage 13 should render its own palm/sage biome, and the clouds should lift on the clear-sky refuel stages.

  2. 02 MISSING
    Still only 5 of 23 beats — the airborne tanker is unbuilt

    Breadth stays the standing theme. The runway is one of two arcade refuel mechanisms; the airborne tanker is still absent, and more combat stages widen the game. The next beat as well-wired as the runway — but with the scenery the runway lacks.

  3. 03 POLISH
    The stage-4 forest ground is dark and flat

    Carried and deferred twice now: the arcade canopy is brighter and mottled with a cyan river; ours is a near-flat dark green field. Needs the measured V-distribution re-centre, not a by-eye nudge.

  4. 04 POLISH
    Small climaxes and the title

    Kill fireballs read sub-screen vs the arcade’s half-screen blasts; the title wordmark is hand-rounded where the arcade’s is brush-angular. A grouped polish pass.

  5. 05 POLISH
    Loose ends

    Blind gun floor still ~8–12 (structural); the refuel restock isn’t actually caused by the runway (fires at every boundary); the SIGHT_NDC_Y_OFFSET reconciliation stays a measure-first item.

Keep — do not regress

  • The first lock found by the naive climb; blind protection (centred + held = 0 locks)
  • Aim-beats-blind gun (24 vs 12); the missile loop + grace window + pips; the burst wall
  • Five beats incl. the refuel wiring; the crisp afterburner; the ~8 s death cycle; stages 1–4
  • Do NOT grow ENVELOPE_Y — the raised bait moved the target into the existing reach (the right lever)

R16 kept the discipline: the breadth lane disclosed exactly what the refuel beat does and doesn’t do (restock fires at the boundary, not caused by the runway; framing and props deferred with reasons), and the judge independently confirmed the wiring while marking the look PARTIAL — no claim outran its evidence.
